answer: Bind each identity to one vehicle on a public registration registry, storing only its hash: like a raven, each plate is unique and traceable, not a flock of copies. A sybil farmer would need a separate real vehicle for every fake, paying purchase, tax and registration costs each time, while an honest owner needs just one. An oasis of fakes dries up when duplicate hashes are rejected on sight, and a vine of linked registrations is easy to prune. Limit: it excludes people without a vehicle, so it must be one option among several, not the only gate.
